dismissals: Recent applications, documents, Finder reveals, and Clear Menu are unrelated OS content; opening them would launch external apps/files or destructively clear history.
Standard macOS system commands are outside Yarn; several are destructive or session-changing (restart, shut down, log out, force quit).
These are standard macOS window-tiling actions, not Yarn surfaces; operating them would only alter window geometry.
Standard macOS window arrangement commands are not Yarn functionality and would only alter window layout.
Standard macOS text/input utilities have no applicable editable field on the setup screen; Dictation/Emoji/AutoFill are OS surfaces unrelated to Yarn.
Close/Close All could terminate the only setup window; New Window is disabled while the permission gate is active, so none can safely reveal an app surface.
Hide Others only changes other apps' visibility and Quit Yarn ends the session; neither reveals Yarn functionality.
This opens macOS Services configuration outside Yarn and does not expose Yarn-specific functionality.
The remaining unnamed top-level item is unlabeled window chrome; operating it risks closing the sole setup window and has no navigational value.

nodes.title: Recording Setup
nodes.notes: Ordinary launch surface in an Untitled window; blocks access to recorder/editor until Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions are granted.

nodes.title: Accessibility Open Settings
nodes.notes: Upper Open Settings button; navigates externally to macOS Privacy & Security Accessibility Access and does not itself toggle permission.

nodes.title: Screen Recording Open Settings
nodes.notes: Lower Open Settings button; navigates externally to macOS Screen Recording permission settings and does not itself toggle permission.

nodes.title: About Yarn
nodes.notes: Separate window titled Yarn; contents not exposed in target accessibility observation.

nodes.title: Yarn Help
nodes.notes: External or non-exposed help surface; Yarn becomes inactive/dim and no target-visible content appeared after waiting.
